analysis.reasonEn: The upward trend has continued for three consecutive sessions since the last buy entry. RSI has consolidated above 60, and the MACD histogram continues to improve, indicating an expanding bullish phase. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day high being renewed. Although trading volume has slightly contracted, the uptrend remains intact. A break above 39,950 KRW is expected to unlock further upside potential.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (39,950 KRW) vs SMA5 (38,763 KRW)/SMA20 (36,882 KRW)/SMA50 (35,044 KRW): Short-to-mid term trend above moving averages, indicating bullish dominance.
· Position relative to SMA100 (41,315 KRW)/SMA200 (35,122 KRW): Mixed long-term trend, with short-term bullish strength.
· 52-week position (60.2%): Current price level is in the historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.0→60.7): Staying in neutral territory, pre-overbought stage.
· MACD histogram trajectory (290.8438→320.2602): Continuous improvement, signaling expanding bullish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 36,882 KRW): Consolidating near the mid-band, with a reasonable band width of 19.85%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (34,485 KRW): Based on Pivot S1 (35,087 KRW) and SMA50 (35,044 KRW).
· Swing resistance (50,515 KRW): Breaking this level is expected to unlock further upside potential.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): Reinforcing the recovery trend signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.83x): Contracted compared to the previous average, suggesting potential weakening of upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry upon breaking 39,950 KRW, stop loss if 38,271 KRW is breached.
